controls.reason: Aging, recurrence, escape phase and source can be recorded, but corrective-action effectiveness requires causal outcome judgment over future recurrence.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Every defect row can contain all five fields while an ineffective action is marked effective merely because the defect has not yet recurred.

controls.reason: A file-change record does not prove that seven artifacts were substantively and correctly updated in response to the defect or incident.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Each named artifact can receive a timestamp or cosmetic edit while the monitoring rule and training still teach the faulty behavior.

controls.reason: A defect workflow can deterministically block closure unless its versioned completion criteria evaluate true and all required evidence bindings exist.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A closed defect with a failed criterion or missing evidence cannot pass the exact state-transition guard and signed evidence-manifest check.

controls.reason: The authoritative incident and defect ledgers can be checked for append-only retention of prior states and identifiers needed for trend queries.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Deleting or overwriting a historical state changes the ledger chain or leaves a missing event, so the proposed false pass is rejected.

controls.reason: A versioned assurance strategy can expose explicit links among the eight finite domains named by the rule rather than an isolated testing node.
controls.counterexample_analysis: If product risk or operations has no linked assurance activity and evidence relationship, the exact eight-domain strategy graph fails.

controls.reason: Within the sealed assurance-scope registry, the eleven named scope dimensions can be required as explicit, identity-bound inventory sections.
controls.counterexample_analysis: An in-scope interface or environment without a corresponding scope identity fails the registry join; the check makes no claim about excluded scope.

controls.reason: Materiality and residual uncertainty require contextual judgment, and unknown assumptions or inaccessible supplier components cannot be proven complete by their own record.
controls.counterexample_analysis: All six sections can be populated while a critical unstated data assumption and an inaccessible transitive supplier component are omitted.

controls.reason: A pre-implementation, versioned matrix can map every registered lifecycle stage and quality attribute to its required evidence type and authority.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A stage or attribute without an evidence definition, or a definition created after implementation began, fails the finite matrix and timestamp checks.

controls.reason: Every registered assurance activity can be assigned one or more of the six exact execution and oversight modes in a structured plan.
controls.counterexample_analysis: An activity with no automation, manual, witness, formal, external or monitoring classification fails the finite activity-register join.

controls.reason: Whether a change is material requires contextual or legal judgment, and complete detection of supplier, regulatory, user and threat changes is unbounded.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Configured change events can all trigger reviews while an applicable regulatory change is missed or an architecture change is wrongly called immaterial.

controls.reason: Document presence is bounded, but deciding which production-evidence conditions and controls actually make testing safe requires security, privacy and operational judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A policy can list approval and rollback controls while production tests still expose real customer data or cause unsafe side effects.

controls.reason: Identifying an authoritative basis for every behavior requires a complete behavior inventory plus legal and product judgment about conflicting sources.
controls.counterexample_analysis: All registered behaviors can link to documents while an undocumented failure behavior has no basis or a contract incorrectly loses to an internal policy.

controls.reason: Which requirements are critical and whether criteria are truly measurable and sufficient require project-specific quality judgment beyond field presence.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Every tagged critical requirement can have the five fields while a genuinely critical recovery requirement is untagged or its outcome remains ambiguous.

controls.reason: Given sealed critical-requirement, risk, activity and result registries, both directions of the traceability relation are exact graph joins.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A critical risk with no verification activity or a result with no requirement or risk target leaves a deterministic missing edge.

controls.reason: A test-result provenance manifest can bind the exact eight product, configuration, data, dependency and environment identities listed by the rule.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Changing a feature flag or dependency version without a new bound result changes the manifest identity and prevents the old evidence from passing.

controls.reason: Determining that a requirement cannot be fully tested and selecting adequate alternative proof, review, monitoring or operations controls requires contextual assurance judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A record can label a difficult requirement untestable and name a superficial document review while feasible testing and necessary runtime monitoring are omitted.

controls.reason: The rule gives no authoritative inventory of required negative requirements or prohibited states, so mere presence cannot prove meaningful completeness.
controls.counterexample_analysis: One trivial prohibited state can satisfy a category check while dangerous deletion, authorization and recovery states remain unspecified.

controls.reason: Identifying the invariants that must remain true is a semantic design judgment, and six labeled invariant records do not prove the essential invariants are covered.
controls.counterexample_analysis: The plan can state a harmless invariant for every operation class while omitting the balance-conservation invariant that retries can violate.

controls.reason: Where each tolerance is relevant and what quantitative threshold is acceptable require workload, risk and product judgment not supplied by the rule.
controls.counterexample_analysis: All seven tolerance fields can exist while an inappropriate latency or numerical-error limit allows materially wrong behavior.

controls.reason: Acceptance policy can require explicit criteria entries for the six finite cross-cutting quality areas named by the rule.
controls.counterexample_analysis: If privacy or recoverability is relegated to an optional audit and lacks a release acceptance criterion, the exact six-area mapping fails.

controls.reason: Technology-neutral intent and whether criteria are truly independent of one implementation are semantic properties that cannot be settled by syntax alone.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A criterion can avoid product names yet encode one implementation's internal queue behavior, passing a keyword check while violating neutrality.

controls.reason: Versioned requirement-to-evidence lineage can deterministically invalidate every evidence node reachable from a changed test-basis identity pending review.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A requirement change that leaves an affected result valid violates the exact dependency graph and invalidation state transition.

controls.reason: Determining whether examples or mockups silently became normative requires semantic provenance and observation of informal approval and development practices.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A mockup can remain labeled non-normative while teams implement and test against it instead of the specification, with no explicit approval record.

controls.reason: Owner and deadline fields are checkable for recorded items, but no authoritative source proves that every unresolved question and assumption was recorded.
controls.counterexample_analysis: All rows can have owners and dates while a known unresolved privacy assumption is omitted, yielding a structurally complete false pass.

controls.reason: For every test in the sealed test registry, an explicit correctness oracle type, authority, comparison rule and expected outcome can be required.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A test that only records process exit success and has no correctness comparison cannot satisfy the exact oracle-definition schema.

controls.reason: High-impact classification, source authority and true independence of a reference implementation or model require contextual and specialist judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A high-impact result can be checked by a nominally separate implementation copied from the same flawed formula, so execution evidence falsely passes.

controls.reason: Logical independence cannot be proven from module or repository separation, and whether an implementation is defect-prone requires engineering judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: The expected-value tool can live in a separate package but duplicate the same faulty algorithm line for line, passing provenance-only checks.

controls.reason: Occurrence of review, examples, cross-checks and fault injections does not prove the oracle is valid without a complete independent correctness oracle.
controls.counterexample_analysis: All four activities can run against examples that share the same mistaken expected value, leaving a systematically wrong oracle approved.

controls.reason: An oracle schema can explicitly distinguish the six finite expectation kinds and require kind-specific parameters rather than treating them as exact values.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A statistical expectation stored as an exact scalar fails its declared-type schema, while temporal and eventual outcomes require their own bounded fields.

controls.reason: The rule lacks an authoritative inventory of relevant intermediate states and side effects, so eight labeled oracle sections do not prove complete observation.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A test can define one oracle in every named category while omitting a critical external payment call or audit-record mutation.

controls.reason: Correctness of error type, message class, retryability, status and recovery behavior requires complete error-state coverage and authoritative semantic oracles.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Named error fixtures can all match expected fields while an untested partial-failure path returns a retryable error that causes duplicate work.
